gaps.sentence: I ___ the car tonight, so take a taxi into town.
gaps.hint: a future activity in progress as reason
gaps.explanation: The future continuous can express something in progress around a future time, here as a polite reason: will be using.

gaps.sentence: Don't disturb him — he ___ an important video call with the client.
gaps.hint: do not disturb means it is happening now
gaps.explanation: An action in progress at the moment of speaking takes the present continuous: is having.

gaps.sentence: I ___ this temperature to the heat.
gaps.explanation: 'Prefer' is a state verb and takes the present simple: prefer.

gaps.sentence: The soup ___ delicious, but I think it needs a little more salt.
gaps.hint: taste describing a quality is stative
gaps.explanation: When 'taste' describes a quality of something, it is a state verb: tastes.

gaps.sentence: At midnight, the protesters ___ outside the parliament, refusing to move.
gaps.hint: at midnight, in progress at that point
gaps.explanation: An action in progress at a specific past moment takes the past continuous: were standing.

gaps.hint: how long plus since needs present perfect
gaps.explanation: 'How long' questions about periods that include the present take the present perfect: have you known.

gaps.sentence: She has bought the paint, so tomorrow she ___ the kitchen.
gaps.hint: an intention already decided before speaking
gaps.explanation: An intention decided before the moment of speaking uses 'be going to': is going to paint.

gaps.sentence: The moon ___ round the Earth roughly every 27 days.
gaps.hint: a timeless fact about the moon
gaps.explanation: Timeless facts take the present simple: goes.
